title: Let Me In
lyrics:
I will follow you
Wherever you take me
And I'll take the risk
Whatever it may be

She said "Hush, little baby
Don't say a word, I will make it fun tonight"
And if she will be my lover
Only to discover that she only does it right

And you let me in
Knowing where I've been

Forgetting who I am
And you make me feel ok, again

Regresarás a mi
Solo dime que si
Te esperé y quiero saber si me arrepentiré
Yo no sé, decidí ya no seguir en este amor

No, baby, I can't be your man
'Cause I know where you've been
Won't play me like you did... again

I have yet to trust you on your ways
And I don't think I can
No, I don't think I can

Oooh Ooooh Oooooooh
Oooh Ooooh Oooooooh
